findings.title: Public functions removed/renamed without updating other callers or tests
findings.body: The PR deletes `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, `SimpleCheckIn` and the failure-status maps from `mark_failed.py`, and renames two of them. The diff shows no updates to tests or other modules that import them from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed`. Any such import will now raise ImportError. Existing tests that patch `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.*` (e.g. `produce_occurrence_to_kafka` or `create_issue_platform_occurrence`) will also break. Update the callers and tests, or re-export the old names.

findings.title: Copied config is computed but the original config is returned
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` builds a copy of the config with `schedule_type` replaced by its display value. It then returns `monitor_environment.monitor.config`, the unmodified original, so the copy is never used. The intended display-friendly `schedule_type` never reaches the event context. This bug was carried over in the move, so this is a good moment to fix it by returning `config`.
